quote: If any driver or operator of a motor vehicle drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator, the driver or operator shall: If the highway has one lane for traveling in each direction and the width of the paved portion permits, drive to the extreme right side of the highway and, if applicable, comply with the provisions of NRS 484B.630.

activation.condition: Motor-vehicle driver travels so slowly as to impede traffic immediately behind on a highway with one lane in each direction, if paved width permits.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Distinct original follower and subject histories required; no legal speed or gap cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind

judgment_calls_needed.note: Actual paved edge, body footprint and obstruction require review; no clearance cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: the width of the paved portion permits

judgment_calls_needed.note: Original highway edge, paved edge and subject footprint require review; no lateral cutoff.
judgment_calls_needed.phrase: extreme right side of the highway

obligation.description: Drive to the extreme right side and, if applicable, comply with NRS 484B.630.

timing.description: During the qualifying slow-drive episode; NRS 484B.630 applicability and timing remain unresolved.
